prior_geometry.description: Backbone bond and angle priors use the same site-0 chain; fit is performed on reconstructed rigid CG geometry.

g4_topology.morse_representation: complete K4 per tetrad, site-site CG_DG_B3, r0/a fitted from the mapped all-atom reference (fit_tetrad_site_morse.py, D=50.0, width=mad)
g4_topology.stacking_representation: site-site CG_DG_B5 Morse between stacked guanines (same G-tract, adjacent tetrads), r0/a fitted from the mapped all-atom reference (fit_tetrad_site_morse.py, D=50.0, width=mad)
g4_topology.twist_representation: cosine dihedral CG_DG_B3-CG_DG_B5-CG_DG_B5-CG_DG_B3 between stacked guanines (same G-tract, adjacent tetrads); phi0 = circular mean, K = kappa kT from the von Mises fit of the mapped all-atom reference
g4_topology.backbone_dihedral_representation: cosine dihedral on backbone site 0 of four consecutive nucleotides; phi0 = circular mean, K = kappa kT (von Mises) from the mapped all-atom reference, K <= 100.0 kT
g4_topology.hoogsteen_second_hbond: Morse CG_DG_B2(i)-CG_DG_B4(j), N2-H...N7 of each Hoogsteen pair, direction and sides from the mapped all-atom reference, D=50.0, width=mad
g4_topology.loop_contacts: persistent loop-base contacts from the mapped reference: median <= 0.9 nm, sigma <= 0.07 nm, min_sep 2, copy_tol 0.1 nm, site_choice sigma, max_per_base 3, face_tetrads '4,12,16,22;6,10,18,24'; Morse D=50.0
g4_topology.cbt_dihedrals: roles ['backbone']: angle-damped dihedral V = K g(t1) g(t2) (1 - cos), g = 1 for sin t >= 0.3, x(2-x) below (x = sin^2 t / S0^2); K rescaled by 1/<g1 g2> over the mapped reference, K <= 100.0 kT
